reviews.rationale: The 'incapable of unique ideas' part is contradicted: e1–e3 show expert-verified new results from LLMs before the post. The 'untrustworthy in their outputs' part is supported by OpenAI's admission that hallucination persists (e4). The efficacy and subsidy parts are unscored.
